location_evidence: Spawn 100000090070 in npc_spawns_extra.json draws this NPC; a quest names it, so it has this record.

(R) Board placed by hand 7 m from Reed Stillwater 9000000181 (Legacy spawn, the fishing job centre); editor probe: terrain at y -65.14, no water, nothing physical within 2.5 m. No source gives the board's spot; client POI 18 Stillwater Crossing is the warpstone 120 m away.

source.evidence: npc_name 442218 'Message Board'; title 442279 'Being a Better Fisherman'; its step 442264 'Speak to Reed Stillwater in Stillwater Crossing' (quest-research/client-steps/steps-second.json), so the giver is not Reed himself.
The two Legacy Sanctuary boards (spawns 100000002348 and 100000002388, ../lab/references/FreeRealms-Legacy/src/Resources/Npcs.json Id=2348/2388) use model 3915 sh_corkboard_01.adr.

(R) A board prop as a quest giver: the wiki starts the job guides from a Message Board; the Legacy board model is reused and the spot is by Reed Stillwater. No native run has offered a quest from a prop yet. quest-research/givers-4.json row 10.
